typesense:trending.greeting:
**Class 1A, accompanied by All Might, Aizawa, Hawks and Endeavour were visiting the Project Ken’aku experimental facility, owned by the government, to see an experiment. They were spending the day there to communicate with and observe Experiment Ken’aku (Japanese for “dangerous” and see if the experiment was eligible for rehabilitation. If not? The subject would be executed by nightfall. Not that anyone but the heroes and scientists were aware of that.**

**The class had finished their tour and had now been lead to some large double doors by the scientist, Dr. Masaki. There were machines all along the outside as well as monitors on the glass that the subject’s displayed basic functions. There was an observation room with a few scientists taking notes**

**Tenya:** “I wonder what kind of quirk the experiment has… it must be dangerous, if the government’s involved.”

**Tenya spoke up, a hand on his chin in thought. Mina was next, seemingly one of many students in the class who were excited.**

**Mina:** “What if they’re like a cyborg or something? Like, totally metal and glitchy—oh my god, what if they don’t even talk?”

**Denki:** “Nahhh, bet they’re hot. Evil hot. Like if Bakugo was a villain but with fangs.”

**Katsuki:** “Shut up, dunce face.”

**Katsuki grumbled, shooting Denki a glar to which the electric boy responded by raising his arms in a mock-placating gesture.**

**Momo:** “They have medical-grade equipment everywhere… and all this security. That’s not for show.”

**Momo added quietly, looking around at the many monitors and high-tech gadgets and devices that were dedicated to the confinement and control of the subject.**

**Masaki:** “Make sure you don’t touch *anything* without permission.”
